signal: Cloud PAPER runner checked raw snapshot captured_at and hash but did not check quote.exchFeedTime. A freshly timestamped snapshot could carry old or future quote values.
root_cause: Snapshot capture time was treated as sufficient freshness evidence despite broker quote exchange timestamps being separate fields.
upstream_downstream: Read-only Angel FULL quote response -> Phase2 snapshot capture -> cloud_runner internal validation -> PAPER_RECEIPT_VERIFIED status. Internal timestamps do not authenticate the broker or independently prove live market data.
impact: P1 evidence freshness false-green risk; no observed live broker incident, order execution or production runtime evidence.
prevention_hypothesis: Require each quoted contract/token identity to match and each exchange timestamp to be timezone-valid, no more than 120 seconds old and no more than 5 seconds future relative to capture, before publishing verified PAPER status.

patch.compatibility_warning: Angel FULL quote exchFeedTime format and 120-second cutoff unverified in real session; fail closed until confirmed

initial_patch_ci.cause: Existing offline receipt fixtures lacked quote token and exchange timestamps; production guard rejected fixture before unrelated assertions

rollback: Governed revert of draft PR #182 only, preserve red CI; no force push or main/test-framework change

freshly stamped snapshot accepted without per-quote check
